== Notes ==
* Temporarily swap to a [[weapon swap#Energy|high-energy set]] if you think you'll need the boost to have more energy than your target. 
* Especially potent in environments with opportunities to clear exhaustion ([[flag running]], [[splitting]]) and [[Random Arenas]] - since matches tend to be short, you'll often kill the other team or lose before exhausting out)
